name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 5 No 8

clue.text: Fleecy cloud returning low around the Circle with a flock
Person who’s old-fashioned and also honest
Emptying a sweeper, one sound as a bell
Undercuts of beef given by the French in the midst of attacks
Whirl around quietly and drive off
First-class railway spirit? That’s fanciful
Dancing in tunics near places like the Roman Forum
In which some groups sing, and finish to ruin “Old New York’ (5,7) i Judge appearing, in a way, as bar sister?
Mounted jockey having a slight advantage?
A thousand beheaded every Sunday, say, without resistance?
Polite Scot, maybe, one not in uniform
What sounds like a dandy commercial for a gadget
At camp, possibly, lay disheartened, watchfully
Bloodless, mostly, and extremely unsteady
Hold trophy, awfully coy about it
Sulks with classy weapon, showing peevishness
Tainted? MO can work out it is so!
Tuft of hair’s cock-eyed, with both ends snipped off
Retreat in island is needed for gland inflammation
A writer, for example, is visible in English street
Broadcast lambasts embassy in which king is sheltering
Aim or send haphazardly, set up so as to occur by- chance
Saloon initially overfull, made off
Dark yellow turned-up hat
One guilty of discrimination is observed in ecclesiastical office
Bibulous, and apt to cadge?
Maker of molehill or mountain found in the reserves
